Screenshots.Caption: Umbrella: one AI connection for your whole Umbraco site
How it works: your AI tool starts one MCP server, which asks the site which products it has and loads only their tools, prefixed per product
Many AI agents, each with its own access: every API user gets Off, Read-only, No deletes or Full per product
Connect in minutes: the Umbrella dashboard hands each AI tool a ready-made setup to copy, and Claude Code can install Umbrella as a plugin that asks for the secret
Set up a person in one panel: New connection creates their API user, its access and its secret, then hands over the config for their AI tool
Made for teams: everyone signs in as their own API user, so access follows the person
